title: 9、不是可爱是可口，不是美丽是美味

content_zh:
泉镜花和夏风瑶一头雾水的跟着这位中年秦老师走向了公司之中的女生练功房。
本来的话，公司之中这种资源应该是很紧迫的。大型的公司虽然资源多，但是旗下的艺人之类也多，而小型的更是缺少资源。
不过星光现在颇有些树倒猢狲散的味道，竟然白白空出了许多的地方。这时练功房里空无一人。
“脱吧！”
那秦老师转过身来对着两人说道。
“为什么会有这种事情，这不是检查资质吗？我练散打的时候都没有要脱衣服的！”夏风瑶紧张的喊道。
泉镜花也问道：“为什么要脱掉啊。不是学习跳舞的么？”如果不是看这位秦老师也是女性的话，泉镜花已经要准备和夏风瑶一起逃跑了。
“别紧张，只是稍微的多看一点而已。如果只是普通的学习跳舞的话，那自然是随便了。不过，如果目标不一样的话，那自然需要看的东西也不一样了。”秦老师宽慰着两人。
南香绫也坐到了一旁的休息的地方观看着。
秦老师解释道：“你们两个应该都没有学过舞蹈，暂时也没有衣服给你们，你们也不需要太紧张。并不用将你们两个脱光光，只要看看体型肌肉就好。”
秦老师说着，开始检查起夏风瑶的身体。
“身材很匀称，平时锻炼的很好，完全不像是初中生的身材。”
“这很好么？”南香绫在一旁问道。
“不好说。”秦老师脸色有些难看的说道：“以我一个专业人士的角度来看，这自然是极好的，这是健康优秀的身材。但是你要懂的，专业人士眼中的美和普通大众眼中的美是完全不一样的。在我眼中，这个身材充满了青春的活力，朝气蓬勃。但是在普通人看来，说不定有点男性化了也说不定。”
南香绫皱了皱眉头，点了点头说道：“的确，有的时候病弱反而更好一点。那么单纯的从舞蹈方面来看呢？”
“我想大部分的动作应该难不住她吧，她有练武过，套路的话，也会有很多很美的动作，不过跟舞蹈还是不太一样，最重要的是风格的调整。”
“我学习的可不是表演，是散打哟！”
夏风瑶有些看不过，争辩道。
秦老师没有争辩，而是看向了泉镜花。然后，她微微一呆。
“怎么了，是身材不够好吗？”

南香绫问道。
“不是，只是没发觉，竟然意外的有料呢！”秦老师笑了笑说道，“不过，已经是初中生，也要学会成长之后的衣物。这样对身体可不好。”
南香绫站起身来，走了过来看了看说道：“原来如此，的确，必须好好选择，这对于你今后的胸型也很有关系，我会为你准备特别的货。保证成长不受影响，恩，从初始条件来看，一开始就非常完美啊。”
“不用盯着看啊！”泉镜花有些尴尬的说道。
而秦老师仔细的上下检查了一下说道：“这个孩子不错呀。”
“很适合舞蹈吗？”
“那倒不是，只是开始的时候觉得还好，现在越检查越觉得厉害。整体上很完美，就是各自小了点。怎么说呢，有点缩水了的完美的感觉。”
夏风瑶不禁在一旁说道：“但是胸没缩水呢！”
“不，其实单纯算大小的话并不大，只不过人那么小，所以相对来说就大了很多。”
“相对么？”
“相对，怎么说呢，她的身材，刚开始看上去并不显眼，仔细观察了才觉得好。我觉得也是因为身材娇小，所以相对的身材缩水了一眼看不出来。形体也不夸张。”
“就是说，并不像欧美人那样对吧。”南香绫读懂了舞蹈老师的意思，开口说道。
“没错，很有东方的味道，但既不是古典也不是优雅，并没有强硬的古风美人的感觉。非常的自然。我倒是想到了一个词语，玲珑。非常适合这种身材啊。”
“玲珑吗？真是十分适合的词语啊，不仅有玲珑的身材，还有玲珑的声音。之后得找音乐的老师了。”南香绫推了推眼镜，带着思虑自言自语道。
听到几人的对话，泉镜花赶紧穿好衣服，这也是她有些苦恼的地方。
这个身体如果以她前世的眼光来看，根本不能用可爱来形容，而是应该用可口来形容。
不是美丽，而是美味。
仿佛是儿童蛋糕一样，尤其是这儿童蛋糕上还有两颗小草莓作为点缀。泉镜花自己都从来不敢在完全暴露的情况下照镜子。生怕自己把自己给魅惑了，要是自己对自己有感觉了，再以自己那奇葩的体质，那是真的要把自己给玩坏掉了。

Quan Jinghua and Xia Fengyao were confused and followed the middle-aged teacher Qin to the girls' training room in the company.
Originally, this kind of resource should be very urgent in the company. Although large companies have many resources, they also have many artists and the like, while small companies lack resources.
However, the starlight now smells like a fallen tree and a hozen scattered, and a lot of space has been left in vain. The practice room was empty at this time.
"Take it off!"
Teacher Qin turned around and said to the two of them.
"Why does this happen? Isn't this a qualification check? I don't even have to take off my clothes when I practice Sanda!" Xia Fengyao shouted nervously.
Quan Jinghua also asked: "Why do you have to take it off? Aren't you learning to dance?" If it hadn't been for the fact that Teacher Qin was also a woman, Quan Jinghua would have been ready to run away with Xia Fengyao.
"Don't be nervous, it's just a matter of watching a little more. If it's just learning to dance, then of course it's casual. However, if the goals are different, then the things you need to watch will naturally be different." Teacher Qin comforted the two of them.
Nan Xiangling also sat at the resting place and watched.
Teacher Qin explained: "You two have probably never learned dance, and there are no clothes for you yet, so you don't need to be too nervous. There is no need to strip you two naked, just look at your body shape and muscles."
Teacher Qin said and began to examine Xia Fengyao's body.
"The figure is very well-proportioned and I exercise well. I don't look like a junior high school student at all."
"Is this good?" Nan Xiangling asked from the side.
"It's hard to say." Teacher Qin said with an ugly face: "From my perspective as a professional, this is naturally excellent. This is a healthy and excellent figure. But you have to understand that the beauty in the eyes of professionals is completely different from the beauty in the eyes of the general public. In my eyes, this figure is full of youthful vitality and full of vigor. But in the eyes of ordinary people, it may be a bit masculine."
Nan Xiangling frowned, nodded and said, "Indeed, sometimes it is better to be weak. So what about purely from a dance perspective?"
"I think most of the moves shouldn't be difficult for her. She has practiced martial arts, and there are many beautiful moves in the routine, but it is still different from dance. The most important thing is the adjustment of the style."
"I'm not studying acting, I'm studying Sanda!"
Xia Fengyao couldn't stand it and argued.
Teacher Qin did not argue, but looked at Quan Jinghua. Then, she paused for a moment.
"What's wrong? Is your figure not good enough?"
Nan Xiangling asked.
"No, I just didn't realize it, but it turned out to be unexpected!" Teacher Qin smiled and said, "However, as a junior high school student, you also need to learn how to dress when you grow up. This is not good for your health."
Nan Xiangling stood up, walked over and took a look and said: "I see, indeed, you must choose carefully. This will also have a great influence on your future breast shape. I will prepare special goods for you. To ensure that the growth is not affected, well, judging from the initial conditions, it is perfect from the beginning."
"No need to stare!" Quan Jinghua said awkwardly.
Teacher Qin carefully checked him up and down and said, "This child is not bad."
"Is it suitable for dancing?"
"That's not true. I just thought it was fine at the beginning, and now the more I check it, the more terrible it becomes. Overall, it's perfect, but each one is a bit smaller. How should I put it, it feels a bit shrunk from perfection."
Xia Fengyao couldn't help but said: "But the breasts haven't shrunk yet!"
"No, actually it's not big in terms of size alone. It's just that people are so small, so relatively speaking it's a lot bigger."
"Relatively?"
"Relatively, how should I put it, her figure didn't look conspicuous at first. It took a closer look to make her feel better.. I think it's because of my petite stature that I can't tell at a glance that my figure has shrunk. The shape is not exaggerated either. "
“That is to say, it’s not like Europeans and Americans, right. " Nan Xiangling understood what the dance teacher meant and said.
"Yes, it has a very oriental flavor, but it is neither classical nor elegant, and does not have the feeling of a tough old-fashioned beauty. Very natural. I actually thought of a word, Linglong. Very suitable for this body type. "
"Linglong? It's a very suitable word, not only for her exquisite figure, but also for her exquisite voice. Then I have to find a music teacher. "Nan Xiangling pushed up her glasses and said to herself thoughtfully.
After hearing the conversation between several people, Quan Jinghua quickly got dressed. This was also where she was a little troubled.
If she looked at this body from the perspective of her previous life, she couldn't describe it as cute at all, but rather as delicious.
Not beautiful, but delicious.
It looks like a children's cake, especially the children's cake with two small strawberries as decoration. Izumi Kyoka herself never dared to look in the mirror when she was completely exposed. I am afraid that I have charmed myself. If I have feelings for myself, and with my weird physique, I will really destroy myself.
